description: A balanced puzzle that requires planning a few moves ahead. Look for the gate order before you start moving blocks.
tips: Plan three moves ahead before sliding the first block.
Treat blocking pieces as 'parking' — slide them out of the way temporarily.
L-shaped and T-shaped blocks usually rotate the puzzle's logic — solve around them first.
When two colors race for the same lane, pick the one whose path is fully open.
Use the preview to confirm a block actually fits its target gate before committing.

faq.q: Why does this level look easier in the video than in my game?
faq.a: Block Out level layouts are deterministic per level number. If your board looks different, double-check that you're on the same level — Daily Challenge and Event boards reuse level numbers.

faq.q: How do I rotate or flip pieces?
faq.a: Block Out doesn't support rotation. The shape you see is the shape you have to slide. Plan around the orientation.

faq.q: Can I undo a wrong move?
faq.a: Yes — tap the undo button after a misstep. Each level allows unlimited undos until you complete it. There's no penalty.

faq.q: What if I'm running out of moves?
faq.a: Restart the level instead of burning hints. Most levels can be solved in well under the move limit once you know the order.
